The petitioner has filed this petition seeking following reliefs:-
"10.
(a) Call for the entire records pertaining to the present case.

Smt. Devkan Bai Bisen vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80770591/
1 b) Issue a Writ of Mandamus directing the Respondent Authorities to initiate the Land Acquisition proceedings for the acquisition of the lands belonging to the Petitioners herein which already stands utilised by the Municipal Corporation,
Raipur, in accordance with the prevailing applicable law, in a time bound manner.
c) Issue a Writ of Mandamus directing the Respondent Authorities to conclude the said Acquisition Proceedings by calculating the Compensation payable to the Petitioners herein as per the dictum of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in (2020) 2 SCC 569: Vidya Devi v. State of Himachal Pradesh & others as well as the Judgements rendered by the Hon'ble High Court of Chhattisgarh in Writ Appeal no. 241/2020:
Ramkrishna Sahu v. State of Chhattisgarh on 09.02.2023 & in Writ Appeal no.
51/2019: M/s.
Natural Collections (LLP), Raipur v. State of Chhattisgarh on 09.03.2023.
d) Issue a Writ of Mandamus directing the Respondent Authorities to conclude the said Acquisition Proceedings by depositing of the Award Amount as contemplated under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 along with Interest @ 12% per annum till the amount is paid.

sentences.text:
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the owner of the land bearing kh.
no.645/14 (re-numbered as 645/20) measuring 1250 sq. ft.
She became owner of the land pursuant to registered sale deed executed in her favour on 12.03.2008.

Respondent /Municipal Corporation Raipur have constructed drain over the portion of private ownership land of the petitioner without acquiring the same in accordance with law and making payment of suitable amount of compensation.

He submits that petitioner has submitted representation initially on 01.08.2018 for initiating land acquisition proceeding and making payment of compensation, however till date claim Smt. Devkan Bai Bisen vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80770591/
2 of the petitioner is not considered and therefore a direction be issued to respondents No. 3 & 4 to take decision on the claim of the petitioner.

entities.text: Devkan Bai Bisen vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for respondents No. 3 & 4/ Municipal Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:19279 -4- Corporation submits that specific pleadings in the writ petition is not made as to the date of construction of drain over her land.
Representation (Annexure P-4) submitted by the petitioner is also 6 years old and therefore if the petitioner submits fresh representation it will be considered and decided in accordance with law.
4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and also perused the documents annexed along with this petition.

5. Taking into consideration the nature of grievance raised in the writ petition that respondents No.
3 & 4 have constructed drain over the portion of ownership land of the petitioner, as stated by counsel for petitioner, without acquiring the land under the law and making payment of compensation, without commenting anything on merits of claim of the petitioner, this writ petition is disposed of permitting the petitioner to file fresh representation before respondents No. 3 & 4 raising all the grievances along with supporting documents and in the event the petitioner files fresh representation, respondents No. 3 & 4 shall consider and decide the same in accordance with law,
expeditiously, preferably within a period of 3 months from the date of receipt of representation.
Sd/---//-/--------/--/-
(Parth Prateem Sahu) Judge Praveen Smt. Devkan Bai Bisen vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80770591/
